description: This Kotlin source file defines a Compose UI screen for the Settings Sheet in an Android app. It handles various device, media, notification, data access, and location settings, managing permissions and system integrations. The code also includes helper functions for querying installed apps and resolving notification packages.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application with label, package name, and system app flag.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of installed apps with their labels, package names, and whether they are system apps, considering launcher, recent, and configured notification packages.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Resolves a set of candidate package names for notification forwarding, excluding the app's own package.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configurations for outlined text fields in the settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Defines common styling for settings row components, including border and background.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for primary action buttons.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for dangerous action buttons (not used in main code).

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Launches the app's settings page in Android system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener settings page in Android system settings.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is granted (Android 13+).

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the notification listener service is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks if the device has motion sensors like accelerometer or step counter.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device supports the assistant role.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app currently holds the assistant role.
